notes.title: v1.06 Update
notes.notes:
v1.06 is live!

Defaulted the game to Window mode
Updated game engine to use new DirectX if available 
Added even more logging to help debugging issues


A big THANK YOU to Frankbrodie for helping us debug and test  

If you have any issues with this build, please let us know via the forums. 

Cheers, 
Steve and Kylie 
The Revills Games

notes.title: v1.04 Update
notes.notes:
New Features and Fixes:

    Synchronizes Steam achievements and Game achievements for the current player on the title screen (incase the player loses Steam connection)
    Various small bug fixes
    Greenlight promo button (please vote ːsteamhappyː)


Thanks, 
Steve and Kylie 
The Revills Games

notes.title: v1.03 Update
notes.notes:
New Features and Fixes:


    Added Round Select Dialog
    Added Map button to the in-game options
    Fixed objectives text when changing languages


Note: If you change the chapter you are currently playing the game will reset the stats and objectives. A dialog is shown to warn you about this.

Thanks,
Steve and Kylie
The Revills Games
